lines.text: Why does AI forget what you told it?
You tell AI your trip budget: five hundred dollars.
Then you keep chatting. Food, weather, what to pack.
A long chat later, it suggests a nine hundred dollar hotel.
That's context rot.
Every message adds another page to its desk.
Your budget's still there, but its attention is spread thinner and thinner.
How do you spot it?
It forgets something you told it.
It repeats a mistake you already fixed.
Or it uses details you changed.
When you see it, don't just keep correcting it.
Ask for a summary of the key facts, then start a new chat with it.
Clean desk. Now it sticks to your budget.
To avoid it in the first place:
New topic? New chat.
Keep key facts up front.
And only share what it needs.
Long chats bury details. When you spot it, start fresh.
